verdict.label: Steady market
verdict.headline: Card prices are steady: no strong move either way right now.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 62.4 (-0.8% in a day) and momentum is 45: prices are steady. 84s cost 950, 85s 3,100 and 86s 6,300. Midweek is usually the quietest time to buy cards for the weekend.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-11-25T18:31:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Debinha 88 Team of the week after its 31% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 57,500 coins. Now 43,750. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 30.7% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 14 of 23 so far, averaging +6.0% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Sell Julian Ryerson 86 Ultimate Scream after its 31% jump, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 24,250 coins. Now 34,000. Sell the spike: a card that jumped in a day often gives part of the jump back within two days. Picked because it is up 31.1% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 8 of 15 so far, averaging +8.0% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Quiet midweek: plan your weekend squad now
moves.detail: Midweek is usually the cheapest time to buy cards you will play at the weekend. The next Rivals rewards come {{t:2026-11-26T07:59:00+00:00}} and add fodder supply.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 950 (1.14 coins per Item Score point), 85s 3,100 (1.48 coins per Item Score point), 86s 6,300 (1.54 coins per Item Score point), 87s 8,000 (1.45 coins per Item Score point), 88s 14,500 (1.75 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 87s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: David Raya and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: David Raya 89 Team of the week -72.0%; Marquinhos 88 Team of the week -68.8%; Mohamed Salah 88 Team of the week -67.5%; Felix Nmecha 86 Team of the week -65.1%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
